page.overview:
Who is Bingo?

Bingo is a character who makes a one-time appearance in the The Super Mario Bros. Super Show! episode "Too Hot to Handle." Here, he is featured as one of the Mushroom inhabitants of Waki-Waki. At one point, Bingo assists the island's leader, Scooter, to try and throw Princess Toadstool into the volcano as a sacrificial offering to the Fire God. This order was not given by the real Fire God but rather King Koopa impersonating him.
